sources.title: TNSWA gazetted Ramsar boundary (RamsarBoundary_2.js, feature 'Pallikaranai Marsh Reserve Forest')
sources.license: public data from a Tamil Nadu government portal, cited with attribution

provenance.note: Shapely/pyproj set algebra over the TNSWA gazetted polygon and the OSM ecological polygon (see methodology key); the run itself was a one-off (no committed script). The 233.06 ha figure is land inside the TNSWA boundary but not mapped as OSM wetland - it cannot distinguish physical conversion from OSM under-mapping (see caveats).

methodology.projection: EPSG:32644 (UTM zone 44N) for accurate area computation in metres
methodology.operations: unary_union per source -> reproject -> set algebra

tnswa_gazetted.source: Tamil Nadu State Wetland Authority QGIS web map (tnswa.tn.gov.in/qgis_web/index.html), feature 'Pallikaranai Marsh Reserve Forest'
tnswa_gazetted.represents: Gazetted Ramsar / Reserve Forest legal boundary

set_algebra.intersection_meaning: Land that is both gazetted Ramsar AND OSM-mapped marsh - the unambiguous core
set_algebra.tnswa_minus_osm_meaning: Land inside the TNSWA boundary but not mapped as OSM wetland - the evidence cannot distinguish physical conversion from OSM under-mapping
set_algebra.osm_minus_tnswa_meaning: Marsh visible in OSM outside the gazetted boundary - either ungazetted ecological extent or OSM boundary overshoot

buffer.computed_from: TNSWA gazetted polygon (the legal basis for the NGT 1km no-build rule)
buffer.legal_anchor: NGT order Sept 2025 establishing 1 km construction freeze pending scientific zone-of-influence mapping

caveats: TNSWA polygon is the gazetted legal boundary; it does NOT reflect current ecological state.
OSM polygon is an OSM mapper's interpretation of current marsh extent; precision varies and last-edit dates vary.

The 233.06 ha figure is land inside the TNSWA boundary but not mapped as OSM wetland. It must NOT be read as 'converted' or 'encroached': the evidence cannot distinguish physical conversion from OSM under-mapping. Visually corroborate before any press use.
Buffer is Minkowski-offset from polygon edge (not circular from centroid). Follows jagged boundary; ~1 km on every side.
